Sorry about the wait on this one, Nathan. Shop···· is paid and unshipped: the B30 plus the Power K., one box from our Tennessee warehouse. It ships October 30.

The Power K. is reserved there already and the B30 is on the incoming batch. You can follow that shipment on its way in at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

We wrote to you on September 15 with the delay and the redesigned cooling, and added the Power K. free with it. Tracking goes to your email the moment the label prints.
